title: Quick Open crash when navigating empty list

CC @stijn-h 

### Steps to reproduce

1. Launch editor
2. Press Ctrl+Shift+O (Quick Open Scene)
3. Quick open dialog appears and is empty
4. You can still navigate it using arrow keys (look at the bottom)

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cb58a1aa-7ce2-454d-9b03-3b77b1918f80

5. If you hold Down to keep moving past the last item, the editor will crash
